repositories.name: ShellCheck
repositories.purpose: Static shell-language diagnostics with explicit source/reporting scope

license.restrictions: Not permissive; covered redistribution requires applicable GPL compliance. Exact artifact/dependency review remains required.

repositories.installation: Existing trusted executable; package manager, prebuilt binary or container documented. Source builds require Haskell toolchain.
repositories.compatibility: Multiple OS installation routes documented; dialect chosen explicitly. Exact installed artifact and application compatibility untested.
repositories.api_mcp: No API credentials or new MCP required for local CLI
repositories.costs: Local compute and review time; no paid service proposed; resource measurements null
risks: Following helpers differs from reporting helper warnings
Dynamic paths and suppressions can leave incomplete coverage
Clean diagnostics do not authorize external effects
Current development docs may differ from stable binary
repositories.future_application: Separate language-diagnostic receipts from external-effect authorization
